scripts.check: pnpm deployment:safety-check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm build:web && wrangler deploy --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm build:web && wrangler deploy --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.dev: pnpm build:web && wrangler dev --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env local
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply vision-maxson-data-staging --local --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply vision-maxson-data-staging --remote --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.db:migrations:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list vision-maxson-data-staging --remote --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.dry-run:staging: pnpm build:web && wrangler deploy --config infra/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env staging --dry-run --outdir apps/api/dist-staging
